sequence_origin: Short authored teaching sequence; energies are real model calculations, not experimental measurements.

provenance.distribution: ViennaRNA==2.7.2 from PyPI, official upstream Python interface

sources.title: ViennaRNA 2.7.2 RNAfold manual: settings and model scope
ViennaRNA Python API: Turner 2004 parameter loading
ViennaRNA energy evaluation for individual loops
ViennaRNA partition function and equilibrium properties

model.salt_interpretation: ViennaRNA default reference condition; computed stack and loop salt corrections are zero. No explicit Mg2+ model.
model.structure_scope: Single linear RNA, canonical and GU pairs, noncrossing secondary structures, minimum hairpin size 3; no constraints, no pseudoknots, no G-quadruplexes.
model.probability_method: Normalized exhaustive Boltzmann sum of all 99 structures evaluated with ViennaRNA; independently agrees with ViennaRNA PF and base-pair probabilities within 1e-6.

interpretation.energy: Loop terms are sequence- and structure-context contributions; do not assign a fixed energy to a GC pair or to one hydrogen bond.
interpretation.comparison: The four-pair larger hairpin is -3.70 kcal/mol; the four-pair frayed stem is -2.60; the four-pair internal-loop fold is +0.20. Pair count alone cannot reproduce these differences.
interpretation.probabilities: Equilibrium model probabilities conditional on the stated sequence, parameters, settings and allowed structures; not experimental confidence.
interpretation.representation_2d: Base-pair topology is computed. Positioning the residues in a 2D drawing is a layout choice.
interpretation.representation_3d: No 3D coordinates or folding trajectories are computed by this generator. A 3D depiction of these pairs must be labeled schematic geometry.
interpretation.candidate_motion: Transitioning between candidate drawings compares structures; it is not a computed kinetic pathway.
